The '''Overlook stage''' was a raised terrace located in the back of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was overlooked by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna's]] [[Veruna's tower/Legends|library tower]] and the palace's rear watchtower. At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], acted as a master of ceremony during the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]], delivering a speech from the Overlook stage.

==History==
The Overlook stage was already a part of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], before [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] added its [[Veruna's tower/Legends|library tower]]. Upon completion of that tower, the Overlook stage was from then on accessed by the library. Traditionally, the Overlook stage housed the main proceedings of the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]], the annual celebration of Naboo's membership of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Ffp34">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 34|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 34]]</ref> At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], was asked to deliver a speech on the Overlook stage for the Festival of Light, which commemorated Naboo joining the Republic. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who were tasked with protecting Palpatine erected a [[Deflector shield/Legends|security shield]] over the stage.<ref name="Crisis" />

==Layout==
The circular Overlook stage was accessed from the lower levels of the [[Veruna's tower/Legends|library tower]] commissioned by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], and was overlooked by the watchtower and its skywalk. Rimmed with [[Stone/Legends|stone]] balustrades, the Overlook stage was paved with highly polished [[Marble/Legends|marble]]. The stage was linked to the library tower by a wide walkway, and a stepped decorative walkway led down an around from the back of the stage. On the occasion of the Festival of Light, the platform was fitted with three banks of seating, as well as with a podium from which speech were given. There were speeder docking points on the stage. During the Festival of Light, those were used by floating [[repulsorplatform]]s, allowing guests to watch the ceremony.<ref name="Ffp34" />
